source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-47

procedures.title: A/C fuses: description
notes: One fuse in the junction block covers the whole A/C system except the blower on high speed.
A second fuse for the high speed blower circuit sits in the wiring between the horn relay and the A/C relay.
Listed under Four-Season and Comfortron systems with no model named.
